On October 16, 2026, Taylor Devices, Inc. (the “Company”) held its 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders (the “Annual Meeting”). At the Annual Meeting, shareholders approved each of Company management’s proposals, which consisted of: (i) the election of Timothy J. Sopko as a Class 2 director, to serve a three-year term expiring in 2029; (ii) the ratification of the appointment of Lumsden & McCormick, LLP as the independent registered public accounting firm of the Company for the fiscal year ending May 31, 2027; and (iii) the approval, on a non-binding, advisory basis, of the compensation of the Company’s named executive officers.
